=== hello, as clang writes it
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.build_version macos, 14, 0	sdk_version 14, 4
	.globl	_main                           ; -- Begin function main
	.p2align	2
_main:                                  ; @main
	sub	sp, sp, #32
	stp	x29, x30, [sp, #16]             ; 16-byte Spare
	add	x29, sp, #16
	mov	w8, #0                          ; =0x0
	stur	wzr, [x29, #-4]
	adrp	x0, l_.str@PAGE
	add	x0, x0, l_.str@PAGEOFF
	bl	_printf
	mov	w0, #0
	ldp	x29, x30, [sp, #16]             ; 16-byte Spare
	add	sp, sp, #32
	ret
                                        ; -- End function
	.section	__TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
l_.str:                                 ; @.str
	.asciz	"Hello, %s!\n"

.subsections_via_symbols
=== globals through the GOT and by page
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.globl	_get
	.p2align	2
_get:
	adrp	x8, _counter@GOTPAGE
	ldr	x8, [x8, _counter@GOTPAGEOFF]
	ldr	w0, [x8]
	adrp	x9, _local_counter@PAGE
	ldr	w9, [x9, _local_counter@PAGEOFF]
	add	w0, w0, w9
	adrp	x10, _table@PAGE
	add	x10, x10, _table@PAGEOFF
	ldr	x10, [x10, #8]
	ret

	.globl	_set
	.p2align	2
_set:
	adrp	x8, _local_counter@PAGE
	str	w0, [x8, _local_counter@PAGEOFF]
	adrp	x8, _environ@GOTPAGE
	ldr	x8, [x8, _environ@GOTPAGEOFF]
	b	_get

	.section	__DATA,__data
	.globl	_table
	.p2align	3
_table:
	.quad	_get
	.quad	_local_counter
	.quad	_set+4
	.quad	_external_thing

	.p2align	2
_local_counter:
	.long	7

	.comm	_counter, 4, 2
.subsections_via_symbols
=== a switch through a jump table in __TEXT,__const
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.globl	_classify
	.p2align	2
_classify:
	cmp	w0, #3
	b.hi	LBB_default
	mov	w8, w0
	adrp	x9, lJTI0_0@PAGE
	add	x9, x9, lJTI0_0@PAGEOFF
	adr	x10, LBB_0
	ldrsw	x11, [x9, x8, lsl #2]
	add	x10, x10, x11
	br	x10
LBB_0:
	mov	w0, #10
	ret
LBB_1:
	mov	w0, #20
	ret
LBB_2:
	mov	w0, #30
	ret
LBB_default:
	mov	w0, #-1
	ret
	.section	__TEXT,__const
	.p2align	2
lJTI0_0:
	.long	LBB_0-LBB_0
	.long	LBB_1-LBB_0
	.long	LBB_2-LBB_0
	.long	LBB_default-LBB_0
.subsections_via_symbols
=== literals by page offset
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.p2align	2
_f:
	adrp	x8, lCPI0_0@PAGE
	ldr	d0, [x8, lCPI0_0@PAGEOFF]
	adrp	x8, LCPI0_1@PAGE
	ldr	s1, [x8, LCPI0_1@PAGEOFF]
	adrp	x0, l_.str@PAGE
	add	x0, x0, l_.str@PAGEOFF
	adrp	x1, L_.str.1@PAGE
	add	x1, x1, L_.str.1@PAGEOFF
	ret

	.section	__TEXT,__literal8,8byte_literals
	.p2align	3
lCPI0_0:
	.quad	0x400921fb54442d18

	.section	__TEXT,__literal4,4byte_literals
	.p2align	2
LCPI0_1:
	.long	0x3fc00000

	.section	__TEXT,__cstring,cstring_literals
l_.str:
	.asciz	"one"
L_.str.1:
	.asciz	"two"

	.section	__DATA,__data
_strings:
	.quad	l_.str
	.quad	L_.str.1
=== zero-filled storage, and symbols of every kind
	.text
	.globl	_bump, _zeta
	.private_extern _hidden
	.weak_definition _weak
	.globl	_weak
	.weak_reference _maybe
	.p2align	2
_bump:
	adrp	x8, _heap@PAGE
	ldr	x9, [x8, _heap@PAGEOFF]
	add	x9, x9, #1
	str	x9, [x8, _heap@PAGEOFF]
	bl	_hidden
	bl	_weak
	bl	_maybe
	bl	_undefined
	b	_zeta
_hidden:
	ret
_weak:
	ret
_zeta:
	ret
	.alt_entry _zeta_inside
_zeta_inside:
	ret

	.lcomm	_small, 4, 2
	.zerofill __DATA,__common,_big,64,5
	.zerofill __DATA,__bss,_heap,8,3
	.comm	_scratch, 256, 4
_constant = 42
	.set	_flags, 0x10
	.globl	_flags
.subsections_via_symbols
=== differences within and across sections
	.text
	.p2align	2
_a:
	nop
	nop
_b:
	ret
_c:
	ret
Lend:

	.const
_sizes:
	.long	_b - _a
	.long	Lend - _c
	.quad	_sizes - _a
	.long	_c - Lend

	.data
_offsets:
	.long	_a - _offsets
	.long	_d - _offsets
	.quad	_b - _a
_d:
	.quad	0
	.long	_later - _d
_later:
	.long	0
	.long	_personality@GOT - .
	.quad	_personality@GOT
=== branches within the section, with and without atoms of their own
	.text
	.p2align	2
_f:
	bl	_g
	b	Lnear
	b.eq	Lnear
	cbz	x0, Lnear
	tbnz	w1, #3, Lnear
	adr	x2, Lnear
	ldr	x3, Lpool
Lnear:
	bl	_f
	ret
_g:
	b	_f
Lpool:
	.quad	0x1122334455667788
=== sections of every kind
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	.p2align	2
_main:
	ret
	.section	__TEXT,__const
_c1:
	.quad	_main
	.section	__DATA,__const
_c2:
	.quad	_main
	.section	__DATA,__mod_init_func,mod_init_funcs
	.p2align	3
	.quad	_main
	.section	__TEXT,__text2,regular,pure_instructions
	.p2align	2
_other:
	bl	_main
	.section	__DATA,__thread_bss,thread_local_zerofill
	.space	8
	.section	__DATA,__objc_data,regular,no_dead_strip
	.quad	_c1
	.data
	.quad	_c2
	.section	__TEXT,__text,regular,pure_instructions
	b	_other
